name: Jinsei wa Joujou da!
source:
Main character suddenly gets transferred to a provincial branch after four years of work. It's much less crowded here, and all the workers have their own peculiarities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公工作四年后，突然被调往地方分公司。这里远没有原部门拥挤，而且每名员工都各有怪癖。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
